label: Vectara
description: Corpus documents, indexing, metadata, jobs and search without generation

operations.name: get_corpus
operations.description: Read the explicitly bound corpus metadata and usage; proves scoped reachability only.

operations.name: create_corpus
operations.description: Create the credential-bound corpus key. Requires account creation permission and may consume account resources.

operations.name: update_corpus
operations.description: Change only the bound corpus name and description.

operations.name: list_documents
operations.description: Read one bounded document ID and selected scalar metadata page; omit document contents.

operations.name: get_document
operations.description: Read one selected document ID, usage and explicitly selected scalar metadata.

operations.name: index_document
operations.description: Index one owned core text document. May consume resources; read back its explicit ID before repeating an uncertain write.

operations.name: merge_document_metadata
operations.description: Merge scalar metadata fields into the selected document using PATCH.

operations.name: replace_document_metadata
operations.description: Replace all metadata on the selected document using PUT. An empty object clears metadata.

operations.name: delete_document
operations.description: Delete one deliberately selected document. The acknowledgement does not verify absence; get it again for readback.

operations.name: search_corpus
operations.description: Retrieve bounded matching text with generation, saved history and query rewriting disabled. Search may consume resources.

operations.name: list_corpus_jobs
operations.description: Read an existing job page filtered to the bound corpus; refuse jobs that also belong to another corpus.

operations.name: get_corpus_job
operations.description: Read one existing exclusively bound job; pending and failed provider states remain explicit.
